instruction.name: vsetnez.v
instruction.description: Set the condition code if the whole vector register is non-zero.

latencies.notes: vj -> fcc. The chain closes through movcf2gr (9 cycles) and vreplgr2vr.w (1 cycle), so 10 cycles of helper latency are subtracted; treat the value as approximate. Raw measurement was 1.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vsetnez.v $fcc0, $vr8; vsetnez.v $fcc1, $vr9; vsetnez.v $fcc2, $vr10; vsetnez.v $fcc3, $vr11; vsetnez.v $fcc4, $vr12; vsetnez.v $fcc5, $vr13; vsetnez.v $fcc6, $vr14; vsetnez.v $fcc7, $vr15
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x0102030405060708; vreplgr2vr.d $vr0, $r4; vreplgr2vr.d $vr1, $r4' --asm 'vsetnez.v $fcc0, $vr8; vsetnez.v $fcc1, $vr9; vsetnez.v $fcc2, $vr10; vsetnez.v $fcc3, $vr11; vsetnez.v $fcc4, $vr12; vsetnez.v $fcc5, $vr13; vsetnez.v $fcc6, $vr14; vsetnez.v $fcc7, $vr15'
